PRODUCTION CHAIN

Gingerbread Man Shop

Trace the material transformations inside the Gingerbread Man Shop. Step order below follows source IDs, not a verified execution schedule.

Game data v30 · build 254Sources & research notes

Recipe

Ratio: 1 Flour + 2 Egg + 1 Stick → 8 Gingerbread Man ratio · decoded

How production works

Workers repeat the recipe while inputs are available and stop when the building's output store is full. The output capacity of the Gingerbread Man Shop has not been established. Capacity and recipe say nothing about speed: cycle time is not yet measured for any building.
